description: This PHP source file serves as a command-line interface (CLI) installer script for the OrangeHRM system. It handles initial setup tasks such as dependency checks, license agreement verification, database configuration, creating the database, applying migrations, creating admin users, and generating configuration files.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a user session in the application, managing session data.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Handles HTTP request processing for the application.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Provides utility methods for setting up the application database and configuration during installation.

classes.name: UserCredential
classes.description: Data transfer object representing user credentials such as username and password.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, used here to simulate a POST request during installation.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: Handles API requests during installation, specifically registration data.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates the database if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Applies database schema migrations for a specified version.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates a new database user for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Writes the configuration files necessary for application operation.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Generates and writes encryption key files if data encryption is enabled.
